Before Isolated the Pump mechanically 
and Electrically
تحقق من أي ضجيج أو اهتزاز في المضخة أو المحرك.
Check any leakage from the pipe connection to the pump.
Check the amount of leakage from mechanical seal, < 50 drop/sec.
Check the safety valve of the pump.
Check the pressure of the pump delivery.
Check the temperature of bearing house.
